statement: For a loopless pseudo-Laman bigraph B=(G,H), put A(S)=(G/S,H\S) and C(S)=(G\S,H/S). Its count satisfies L(B)=L(A({e}))+L(C({e}))+Σ L(A(M))L(C(N)), summing over M∪N=E, M∩N={e}, |M|,|N|≥2 with both quotient bigraphs pseudo-Laman. Contraction and deletion define / and \, respectively. Starting at B=(G,G) gives the generic planar realization count; loops give zero and a single biedge gives one.

answer.text: An exact contraction/deletion recursion computes every Laman graph's generic complex count. The §5 ten-vertex example has 880 realizations.
